queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS cross_rating_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.avg_daily_price - b.cross_rating_avg) AS avg_excess_daily_price FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.avg_daily_price > b.cross_rating_avg

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.avg_daily_price - c.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN cross_rating c WHERE r.avg_daily_price > c.avg_daily_price
